thread:
Nina: Postmortem follow-up from yesterday's latency storm. Pattern: bursty prefix population + HPA flapping -> cache churn -> mass cold model hits. We need a short, playbook-friendly triage sequence, exact commands, and who to call when scale actions fail.

Nina: Goals: 1) one-page 'Quick Triage' at top of runbook; 2) concrete commands for metrics and remediation; 3) clarified escalation chain (oncall -> eng-sre -> platform lead).

Arjun: I'll own the runbook patch. I'll add a 'Quick Triage' header with a 5-step checklist and pasteable commands. Assign Arjun: runbook edit + unit test for diagnostic script.

Ben: I'll rework the playbook to include threshold triggers. Suggest: eviction_rate > 0.05 * cache_size over a 10m sliding window OR model cold hit rate > 30% triggers incident flow.

Priya: Add a tiny diagnostic script and a single-line curl for Prometheus so oncall can run it fast. Example command I used in incident: 

Priya: ```
# recent cold hits (per route)
curl -s "https://prom.redwood/api/v1/query?query=rate(model_cold_loads[10m])" | jq .
# expect: < 0.3 for important routes
```

Marta: Please include the exact Grafana panels and queries we checked. Put panel links in the runbook and a sample query for eviction rate.

Arjun: For immediate mitigation steps I'll add two safe-first options and one emergency option:

Arjun: ```
# safe: increase per-node cache quota (best-effort)
kubectl -n infra patch cm cache-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"per_node_cache_mb":"40960"}}' && rollout restart deploy/cache-service
# fallback: route traffic to warm_variant (fast, reversible)
redwoodctl routes update --route inference-default --model model-v1-warm --reason "incident fallback"
# emergency: pause autoscaler for 10m
kubectl -n infra annotate hpa inference --overwrite runbook/paused-by=incident-handler && kubectl scale --replicas=8 deployment/inference
```

Ben: Add note: routing to warm variant increases p95 by ~40ms and cost approx +$3/hr per 1000 QPS. Include numbers in playbook.

Priya: Also include rollback examples: how to unpin route and re-enable autoscaler.

Incident Bot: Linked postmortem: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/latency-storm-206513 (sha: d4e5f6).

Nina: Owners & deadlines:
- Arjun: runbook PR with Quick Triage + commands + rollback section 16h.
- Ben: update playbook thresholds, Grafana queries & expected impacts  48h.
- Priya: diagnostic script + test harness  72h.
- Marta: run the dev smoke test and verify commands  96h.

Ben: I'll also add a short 'What to expect' blurb for each mitigation (latency/cost/traffic distribution).

Marta: I'll draft a short escalation contact block (pager tags, team's oncall Slack, and platform email alias) and put it in the runbook header.

Arjun: Drafting PR now. Tagging reviewers @Ben @Priya. Please comment inline if you want different wording for commands.

Nina: Great. Once PRs are merged, update the postmortem tracker with links so we can close the loop. Thanks. :v:
